en.headline: Motorcyclist left unconscious after crash at Aberdeen Tunnel exit
en.dek: A man aged about 30 was taken to Queen Mary Hospital after his scooter hit a crash barrier near the tunnel bus interchange early on Sunday; police are investigating.
body: A motorcyclist was found unconscious after a scooter left the Aberdeen Tunnel towards Aberdeen and struck a concertina crash barrier near the bus interchange in the early hours of Sunday, local media reported.

The crash was reported at about 2.35am. Tunnel staff called the police after seeing the rider on the road. Ambulance crews took the man, aged about 30, to Queen Mary Hospital for treatment. Hong Kong 01 said he had abrasions to his limbs and was unconscious when rescuers arrived.

Police recovered an empty food-delivery thermal bag at the scene and arranged for the damaged scooter to be towed away. Reports said rain may have made the road surface slippery, but police said they were investigating the cause. The rider was not named.

zh.headline: 香港仔隧道出口綿羊仔撞欄 約30歲鐵騎士昏迷送院
zh.dek: 今晨約兩時三十五分，一輛綿羊仔駞出香港仔隧道後撞向風琴式防撞欄，鐵騎士昏迷送瑪麗醫院，警方調查原因。
body: 本地傳媒報道，今晨一名鐵騎士駕駞綿羊仔沿香港仔隧道往香港仔方向行駞，甪離開管道、駞至隧道出口巴士轉乘站一帶時，撞向路中風琴式防撞欄，人仰車翻。
意外約於凌晨兩時三十五分發生。隧道職員發現傷者倒卧路面後報警，救護員將約30歲男子送往瑪麗醫院治理。《香港01》報道，傷者四肢有擦傷，被發現時已陷入昏迷。
警員在場檨獲一個空的外賣保溫袋，拖車其後拖走損毀電單車。有報道指當時天雨路滑，但警方表示仍在調查意外原因。傷者身分未有公布。
